我最初的博客是在博客园开通的，目的是为了写一些OI题解与做题心得。然而由于种种原.zh: 我最初的博客是在博客园开通的，目的是为了写一些OI题解与做题心得。然而由于种种原因OI没怎么学，题解也没写几篇。后来22年的疫情网课期间我开始用博客记一些有意思的事情，也花了两天时间尝试用vercel搭一个自己的博客，然而遇到了某些神秘问题，搜索无果后以失败告终。
我最初的博客是在博客园开通的，目的是为了写一些OI题解与做题心得。然而由于种种原.en: My initial blog was launched on Cnblogs, intended for writing some OI problem solutions and problem-solving experiences. However, for various reasons, I didn't study much OI and wrote only a few solutions. Later, during the 2022 online courses amid the pandemic, I began using the blog to record some interesting things, and even spent two days trying to use Vercel to set up my own blog. However, I encountered certain mysterious problems, and after searching without results, it ended in failure.

转完信科后的暑假终于有片刻闲暇重新搭建个人主页，在GPT5.5 Codex的帮助.zh: 转完信科后的暑假终于有片刻闲暇重新搭建个人主页，在GPT5.5 Codex的帮助下，一晚上就把框架搭好了，令人感慨。大一一年写了很多篇博客，当然内容也就是把做过的算法题贴进去，写点思路与心得，现已全部同步至本站。
转完信科后的暑假终于有片刻闲暇重新搭建个人主页，在GPT5.5 Codex的帮助.en: During the summer after transferring to EECS, I finally found some time to rebuild my personal website. With GPT5.5 Codex, I put the framework together in a single evening—quite a change from my earlier attempt. I wrote many posts during my first year, mostly recording algorithm problems I had worked through along with my approaches and reflections. They have all been brought over to this site.
